description.fun: Popplio is a hard-working sea lion pup that snorts water bubbles from its nose and controls them completely, bouncing on them for acrobatic stunts on land. It practises every day with ever-bigger bubbles, which pack a punch when they pop. Its circus-performer look nods to trained sea lions balancing balls on their noses, and standing upright it forms the alchemical symbol for mercury.
description.guide: Popplio is a Water-type sea lion Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Alola in Sun and Moon. It blows balloon-like water bubbles from its nose and uses them in battle and for acrobatic tricks. It evolves into Brionne and then Primarina.
description.tagline: A hard-working sea lion pup that juggles bubbles

description.fun: Brionne is a born dancer: it learns routines by copying its colony, or even humans, and gets excited by any dance it doesn't know yet. It can dance in perfect time with partners it has never met, and big groups dance together on calm, moonlit nights. In battle it dazzles foes with its dance and slaps coloured water balloons at them. It always looks cheerful, letting only trusted friends see it sad.
description.guide: Brionne is a Water-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Popplio's line. A skilled dancer, it confuses opponents with its moves and bursts water balloons against them. It dances to cheer up its Trainer and hides its own sadness from all but those it trusts.
description.tagline: A dancing sea lion that never lets its sadness show

description.fun: Primarina is a sea lion diva crossed with a mermaid: it sings a melody passed down through generations and steers glittering water balloons with its voice, so Trainers take great care of its throat. It treats every battle as a stage, using harmless balloons as platforms to tease foes while others explode on touch. It's the only first partner Pokémon that becomes a Fairy type.
description.guide: Primarina is a Water- and Fairy-type Pokémon, the final form of Popplio, combining a sea lion with a mermaid and an opera singer. It controls water balloons with its singing voice, which is central to how it fights. It has the highest Special Attack and Special Defense of any final first partner Pokémon, excluding Mega Evolutions.
description.tagline: A singing mermaid diva who treats every battle as a stage
